title: Turn View
description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with the next turn drawn on the road as chevrons and a turn card, from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera shows with or without a route. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in this app and set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view. Do not use it together with Waze on cluster on the cluster: set Waze on cluster to HUD only (the cluster and the HUD show 2 videos at most). Calibrate the camera once on
